scope: Managed Agent Control executions; Phase I Milestone 1
freshness_rules: Descriptive implementation claims require a verified commit and inspection/test evidence.
Normative policy records may have null verified_at_commit; they specify required behavior, not verified runtime enforcement.
Missing metadata, overdue review, supersession, or changed referenced source requires a freshness warning and inspection.
Source/tests can establish that implementation documentation is stale; they do not authorize weakening approved policy.
Record contradictions as findings/conflicts. Pause dependent work; resolve through the authorized owner. Never silently choose.
A revision cites the superseded version and approval; historical records are retained.
Legacy current-task/next-task and architecture documents are discovery aids until scope and freshness are verified.
